expert.name: Riya
expert.quote: Sixteen days, three countries and seven hotels. It finishes on the Andaman coast, which is the right way round.
expert.tip: Do the shopping in Bangkok rather than earlier. You will not want to carry it through Cambodia and Vietnam.

summary: Sixteen days through Vietnam, Cambodia and Thailand: Hanoi with Ninh Binh and an overnight cruise in Halong Bay, three nights in Saigon with the Cu Chi tunnels and the Mekong Delta, Siem Reap for Tonle Sap and Angkor, then Bangkok and the Grand Palace, Coral Island from Pattaya and the Phi Phi islands from Phuket.
included: Included: 15 nights with breakfast daily, dinner at the Vietnamese and Cambodian hotels and all meals on the cruise boat; all flights between the countries; private transfers throughout; a Ninh Binh day tour with a cycle ride to Bich Dong; a shared overnight cruise in Halong Bay with the Dark and Bright caves; a Saigon city tour; the Cu Chi tunnels half day tour; a Mekong Delta day tour; a Tonle Sap lake boat ride; an Angkor Wat day tour; a Bangkok city tour with the Grand Palace and the Emerald Buddha; a Coral Island tour from Pattaya; a Phi Phi island day trip with lunch.
not_included: Not included: international flights; Vietnam, Cambodia and Thailand visa fees; other lunches and dinners; travel insurance; personal expenses.
